purpose: Preserve the external development-sample repository exclusions without opening protected held-out input manifests or evaluator label files.
canonicalization: cv_agent.evaluation.datasets.heldout_manifest.repository_key: HTTPS github.com URLs, lowercase owner/repository, trailing slash and .git suffix removed.
url_set_hash_format: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(sorted(canonical_urls), separators=(',', ':')); all URLs in these sets are ASCII.

proof.conclusion: Excluding all 23 VulnGym repository URLs also excludes the 16 current held-out repositories by their frozen preparation lineage; the separate held-out repository exclusion criterion is retained.
proof.method: URL-only raw-catalog extraction, historical URL-only cache metadata, immutable source-manifest Git object identities, the monotone v4 preparation filter, and current aggregate preparation metadata.
proof.old_cache_note: The preserved caches.json is historical metadata from the first v4 split, before Langflow was also excluded. It is a 17-repository superset, not the current exact 16-repository record.
lineage: prepare_heldout_inputs_v3.main reads data/raw/VulnGym/data/entries.jsonl and passes those rows directly to prepare_heldout.
prepare_heldout derives detector repository URLs exclusively from each retained raw row's repo_url; its filters can remove rows but cannot introduce a new repository.
The v3 detector input Git blob is unchanged between the initial v4 preparation commit 2d2bf98, the Langflow-exclusion correction 3a4c208, and the audited project HEAD.
The v4 build_split detector branch only filters the unchanged v3 source subjects by excluded repository URL. Its separate evaluator-label branch does not add detector subjects.

The configuration change from 2d2bf98 to 3a4c208 adds only the Langflow repository exclusion. Removing that URL from the preserved 17-repository cache set produces 16 URLs, agreeing with current summary metadata.
The current v4 detector Git blob is unchanged between 3a4c208 and the audited project HEAD. Its contents were not opened for this proof.
The cache metadata's raw-dataset revision equals the clean local VulnGym Git HEAD. All 17 metadata URLs and the derived 16 URLs are members of the 23-URL raw catalog universe.

metadata_files.role: Historical URL-only cache provenance: dataset identity, 17 URLs and aggregate 152 subjects.
Current aggregate split metadata: 16 repositories and 146 subjects; no per-entry labels used.
Frozen source/output path lineage and explicit MLflow plus Langflow exclusions.
v3 raw-catalog preparation configuration, not its protected detector or evaluator contents.

reader_constraints.raw_extraction_method: Match the 408 literal repo_url fields and JSON-decode only their string values; no preparation function or evaluator was executed.
protected_input_metadata_methods: git status --porcelain for the two exact paths
reader_constraints.historical_report_excerpt_notice: An initial provenance excerpt extended into historical benchmark commentary and an old exact-hit reference. None of that commentary or any entry identity was used in this proof or in the exclusion URL set; protected input and label files were not opened.

future_selection_rule: Before any external sample is selected, canonicalize its repository URL with repository_key and reject membership in excluded_repository_urls. Preserve the existing PyPI/advisory/CWE/entry/dependency criteria, advisory ordering and maximum 15 inspected advisories; this proof changes no other criterion.
